projects.name: AEO Lighthouse
projects.description: Lighthouse-style tool scoring websites on Answer Engine Optimization readiness
projects.stack: Python 3.10+, Svelte/Astro, Convex, Modal, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, NLTK
projects.context: 5 scoring categories: Structured Data (25%), Content Structure (25%), Technical Foundations (20%), AI Discoverability (20%), Authority & Trust (10%). Grade caps: noindex→F, no HTTPS→D, JS-rendered→C, no schema→B. Key issue: scoring inflation — sites get high scores without truly meeting AEO requirements.

tasks.title: Recalibrate scoring system
tasks.description: The scoring is inflated. Need a session to audit real sites, identify where scores don't match reality, and redesign the weighting/caps. This is a full rethink, not individual fixes.

tasks.title: Brainstorm mini app features
tasks.description: Run a brainstorming session about what to put inside the mini app

projects.name: Loops

projects.stack: TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces), Convex backend, Commander.js, Chokidar

projects.context: packages/cli/ — CLI tool, packages/convex/ — serverless backend, packages/shared/ — types. Chrome DevTools MCP integration for AI agents. File watcher syncs to cloud via Convex.

tasks.title: Deploy and test with real Webflow site
tasks.description: Deploy to Cloudflare, then end-to-end test: edit JS locally → verify it appears on a real Webflow staging site in <1s. This is the whole validation — deploy + test is one session.

tasks.description: When an agent marks a task as done, it should also update the description with a short summary of what was actually done. This gives context for future sessions.
